spec.studio_prompt: A minimalist round coffee table, 80 cm diameter and 40 cm high. The design features a slim, circular tabletop resting centered on a broad cylindrical drum base constructed of wide, vertical fluted oak panels. Made entirely from natural light oak showcasing distinct cathedral grain patterns in tones of pale oak (#c1ac90), warm honey wood (#ac8d65), and deeper shadowed grain lines (#91673f) with a smooth matte finish.
